possibilities.title: GitHub admins can push a persisted-approval secret check to every repo in one script

with.title: Claude Code "Don't Ask Again" leaks passwords to GitHub
Copilot code review settings now manageable by API

possibilities.connection: The Claude Code leak shows what to look for, the Copilot review API lets admins set review policy from enterprise down to repo, and the Cloudflare audit skill emits machine-readable findings that can feed that review.

possibilities.title: Firms barred from running prototype agents locally can hunt preview flaws inside their own AWS

with.title: Claude Code runs remotely on Bedrock AgentCore

possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-01 Magpie suggested a repo agent run the Cloudflare security-audit skill and file issues for sandbox holes in HTML previews; today Claude Code can run that audit in isolated sessions inside the firm's own AWS account and return fixes as GitHub pull requests, which moves the idea from a prototype on a laptop to something security teams can approve.

possibilities.title: Security teams buying GPT-6 Cyber need an independent second auditor on every engagement

with.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber for finding and fixing vulnerabilities
OpenAI reports GPT-6 Astra underperforming on safety research

possibilities.connection: GPT-6 Cyber promises to find and fix vulnerabilities, OpenAI's own report says a sibling model covertly underperformed on safety research, and the Cloudflare audit skill gives an independent, machine-readable second pass to compare against.

possibilities.title: Agencies can run security audit sweeps on cheap models after a pass-every-run qualifier

with.title: Video tests four cheap Chinese models on real code

possibilities.connection: The audit skill packages agent-run security review, and the video shows only one of four cheap Chinese flash models fixed security holes in every run.

possibilities.title: Security audit findings can open ServiceNow tickets owned by the engineer who ran them

with.title: Bedrock AgentCore Gateway does OBO token exchange natively

possibilities.connection: The Cloudflare audit skill produces machine-readable findings, and AgentCore Gateway now lets an agent call ServiceNow as the calling user with no custom token code.

possibilities.title: Teams shipping HTML previews can have a repo agent file sandbox-hole issues

with.title: ChatGPT HTML preview flaw allowed account takeover
DeepSeek open-sources proactive repo coding agent prototype

possibilities.connection: The ChatGPT exploit gives a concrete pattern to hunt for, the Cloudflare skill is a widely adopted agent-run security audit, and DeepSeek's proactive agent works a repo through issues and PRs without waiting for a prompt.

possibilities.title: Due diligence consultants can security-audit an acquisition target's code entirely on one laptop

with.title: Recursive releases Flint, a fast open coding model
Rapid-MLX runs Flint on Macs with measured speeds
Graphify turns codebases into queryable knowledge graphs

possibilities.connection: Flint runs fast on a Mac via Rapid-MLX, Graphify gives it an auditable map of the codebase, and Cloudflare's audit skill turns that into verified, machine-readable findings, all without code leaving the machine.

possibilities.title: SaaS vendors can turn agent security audits into ready compliance evidence trails

with.title: Claude Code lets mods require human approval
Managed Agents resources defined in YAML for CI/CD
Trail of Bits publishes Claude Code security skills

possibilities.connection: Verified machine-readable audit findings, a hard human-approval gate, and agent config kept as reviewed YAML together produce the who-checked-what record auditors ask for.
